findings: The A1 alpha build copies experiments/a1-rc1-sprint1 core/web/release into dist/a1.
The A1 course is driven by experiments/a1-rc1-sprint1/core/levels.mjs and registry.mjs.
No inspected A1 loader/build path imports src/hnk/l04-v2-runtime-consumer-v1.mjs.
Therefore L04 V2 governance/runtime-contract integration is confirmed, but end-user A1 course-loader consumption is not yet wired.
